title: Folding electric bikes
evidenceNote: NYC sale rules require accredited-lab certification to UL 2849 for powered bicycles and UL 2271 for removable batteries; manufacturer text is not our independent registry verification. This is not a rider-owned-device ban.
caveat: Published specifications unless explicitly review-tested. Confirm delivered-unit certification, fit and checkout totals.

products.materialCaveat: UL 2849 + UL 2271 stated on exact product page.

facts.Certification: UL 2849 + UL 2271 stated on exact product page.
facts.Evidence: Manufacturer gives 41 lb bike plus 8 lb battery; complete weight is calculated, not independently tested. Hydraulic brakes, PAS + throttle. In stock at check; free shipping advertised.

products.name: Qualisports Volador
products.materialCaveat: Certification limitation: range-wide SGS claim; no Volador-specific certificate found.

facts.Certification: Certification limitation: range-wide SGS claim; no Volador-specific certificate found.
facts.Evidence: Header advertises 38 lb, but detailed table says 41.2 lb including battery; neither is our tested weight. Manufacturer claims range-wide SGS testing to UL 2849 / UL 2271 and says some batches lack stickers. Request exact delivered-SKU lab mark/certificate before purchase. Four colors available in product data; conflicting preorder boilerplate means shipment timing needs confirmation. Free e-bike shipping advertised.
facts.Price basis: USD manufacturer sticker price checked 2026-11-20. Taxes and checkout shipping excluded; availability can change.

products.name: Dahon K-Feather
products.materialCaveat: Certification limitation: no UL 2849 / UL 2271 evidence found.

facts.Certification: Certification limitation: no UL 2849 / UL 2271 evidence found.
facts.Evidence: Electric Bike Report measured 28.3 lb, above Dahon’s 26.4 lb claim. Built-in battery. Independent review reports no UL certification; EN 15194 is not UL 2849. Specification and fit widget differ; confirm fit with dealer. PAS only, single speed, V-brakes. $50 advertised checkout discount excluded because not checkout-confirmed. Available variants at check; shipping/tax unquoted.
facts.Price basis: USD manufacturer sticker price checked 2026-11-20. Taxes and checkout shipping excluded; availability can change.

products.name: Dahon E-Hemingway
products.materialCaveat: UL 2849 + UL 2271 stated on exact product page.

facts.Certification: UL 2849 + UL 2271 stated on exact product page.
facts.Evidence: Manufacturer weight, not an independent measurement. Removable seatpost battery, torque-sensing PAS, seven gears. Battery spec table says 9.5 Ah; prose says 10 Ah—confirm physical pack label. Green and Matt Obsidian available at check. Processing advertised 2–3 business days; checkout shipping/tax unquoted.
facts.Price basis: USD manufacturer sticker price checked 2026-11-20. Taxes and checkout shipping excluded; availability can change.

products.name: Brompton Electric C Line
products.materialCaveat: US C Line page states independent UL 2849 certification; UL 2271 not explicit there.

facts.Certification: US C Line page states independent UL 2849 certification; UL 2271 not explicit there.
facts.Evidence: Photo caveat: manufacturer listing supplied a red-bike lifestyle image, not the priced Palm Green configuration. Exact e-Motiq / SuperRoll 4-speed Palm Green, Mid-bar configuration. Manufacturer weights, not our tests. Removable battery and rollable fold. Inseam and bar choice determine fit. In stock at check; dispatch advertised 3–5 working days, free ground shipping over $125.
facts.Price basis: USD manufacturer sticker price checked 2026-11-20. Taxes and checkout shipping excluded; availability can change.
